messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["morning dose may also help you sleep better", "sleep", "take dose in the morning", "poor sleep", "sleep problems", "naturally peaks in the morning to help wake up", "works better for anxiety", "tell your doctor if you also use", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "twice usual daily dose every other morning", "sleep problems (insomnia)", "unable to sleep", "obstructive sleep apnea", "IV dose can also be given postoperatively", "if desired, you may drink liquid to help swallow the dissolved strip", "doses above 2,000 mg may be better tolerated given 3 times"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
